rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No practitioner named in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "you can't steer what you can't see" (line 17) is a plain maxim, not an overstated slogan needing a boundary paragraph.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No flag phrases ("not an aspirational X", "vendor", "not theoretical", etc.) or combative agent-verbs present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Pronoun/demonstrative referents in closers ("it", "it is") each resolve to a single unambiguous antecedent one sentence prior; no bypass-the-agent punchlines.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Past tense for exercise recap sections — heading and body.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "You now have a map of the window" (line 60) names a still-true artifact state, which the rule's own exception carves out for present tense.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No corrective-gap phrasing or ability-tier pegging; no pre-flight verification gates present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "context window" earned in prework (getting-going.md), not re-earned here per rule's own don't-re-earn guidance; M1 module so bare "M1"-style abbreviations don't apply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Rule is scoped to Agents 101's business-leader audience; this file is AE101 (engineer audience).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "context window" / "/context" used consistently for ambient runtime state; no conflation with persistent memory.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body.
Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No visible body prompt specifies output structure; actual prompt bodies live in the registry and are out of this class's visible scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module — never repeat same Debrief.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No retro-interview or Debrief shape in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "Quote a specific file or function back and ask Claude to confirm it read what it claims" (line 46) routes the actual verification through Claude auditing itself, matching the rule's own prescribed fix shape rather than violating it.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Not a self-study simulation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
